## Clarification of approved local test resource and bounded retry
The owner authorized temporary local PostgreSQL for completing these tests, not a one-shot experiment. The phrase "one container" is a concurrency/ownership boundary: at most ONE active task-owned disposable local PG container at a time, not a lifetime prohibition on replacing an already cleaned test resource after fixture failure. This clarification stays within the existing local-test authorization; do not ask for another permission solely because the previous disposable resource was removed.
Resume SAME original CF author only for missing qualification on corrected fixture cf-real. Preserve failure diagnosis and corrected Git snapshot; retain future attempted input snapshots before changing fixture. Verify prior exact container cleanup and original session/tool liveness before starting replacement. Same pinned PG16.15 image, unique task-owned name, loopback-only, ephemeral tmpfs/private generated credentials, finite expiry, foreground cleanup success/failure. Never touch existing containers/DB/volumes or secrets, no cloud/paid resources or deployment. Bounded replacement only for completing authorized test gates, no indefinite retry/resource loop.
New finite continuation may run <=45min from actual author start, individual heavy gates <=10min, with explicit checkpoint and cleanup. The prior deadline belongs to the expired/stopped attempt and must not force a confirmation-only permission loop; record new stage start/deadline. Execute actual PG and workerd+PG tests, label evidence honestly. After genuine prerequisites PASS, activate executor and serial integration, not historical completed reviews/triage or unaffected tests. If a substantive technical blocker persists, report exact failure and bounded proposal instead of blanket restart. Same six-role roster and original authors; at most one exact completion wait. Remote push/merge/deploy, secrets and library runtime scope remain unauthorized.


## Owner authorization — temporary local PostgreSQL and resume
Owner explicitly approved the previously requested resource: "tak uruchom" in reply to permission for a temporary local PostgreSQL container for tests. Resume the existing playground wave NOW using the existing coordinator/original authors and preserved checkpoints. Do not repeat completed slice implementations, reviews, triage or unaffected gates.
Authorized resource: one uniquely named task-owned disposable local PostgreSQL container for playground qualification, loopback-only port binding, ephemeral/task-owned storage, private generated test credentials, no real user data. Choose compatible exact pinned version based on actual qualification requirements; record image/version/ownership, resource expiry, stop/cleanup commands and finite stage budget. Do not inspect/copy existing secrets/.env or use/change existing databases, volumes or containers. Cleanup only the exact owned resource after tests, including failures; preserve diagnostic evidence without credentials. No cloud resources, paid provisioning, domain, deployment, npm publication or remote push/PR/merge authorization.
Read latest playground_checkpoint and complete consumed-fixes checkpoint first. All R1,L1,U1-U4,F1-F2 are already delivered/qualified; consume original reports and snapshots, not rerun for confirmation. Resume the original CF PoC author only for missing real-PG gates; verify original liveness before dispatch. Qualify actual PG transaction/atomicity/dedup/delayed/retry/recovery/interruption with real supported Workers connection path, distinguishing local Node/Bun PG from workerd+real PG and hosted CF (still NotTested until actually deployed). Do not interpret permission for PG as hosted CF PASS. Activate executor UPVE-1870 when true prerequisites pass, then serial integration UPVE-1872 through original foundation/shared-registrar owner. Safe unavailable retry/redrive/cancel remain unavailable without separately approved library API changes. UPVE-1874 remains deferred, hosting prepare-only.
This is a new authorized continuation after owner blocker, not a silent extension of the expired prior control window. Set finite <=90min stage checkpoints, heavy gates <=10min and one useful exact-child native completion wait; no timer loops. Report actual run/tool start and concrete qualification outcomes. Deliver a locally runnable integrated preview with durable paths/instructions and limitations when ready, preserving owner checkout and completed evidence.


## Current owner authorization — EXECUTE implementation now
Owner explicitly authorized execution in this conversation: "No to jazda z tym". This supersedes historical backlog-only/no-dispatch restrictions below for the playground implementation wave, NOT resource/deployment/push permissions. Begin actual work, not permission-request-only planning. Use existing effect-jobs six-role roster, Codex gpt-6.1-sol explicit medium; no new profiles/fallback. Coordinator owns one active control wave and dispatches same-project original authors after liveness/ownership checks.
Authorized: local application implementation, isolated worktrees, local tests and Conventional Commits, task dispatch and canonical risk-based single-round review/triage/original-author fixes/affected gates. Not authorized: provisioning even free cloud resources, domain purchase, existing secret/.env reads/copies, npm publication, remote push/PR/merge or deployment. Request exact missing resource/budget or remote operation when ready, while continuing independent local work. Existing unrelated work/owner changes preserved. Existing local disposable database creation requires checking actual authorization; do not touch existing databases/containers. Source library runtime changes require a separately approved findings task; read-only app SQL must not bypass lifecycle.
Foundation UPVE-1863 first: preserve library at root; apps/website (docs + /jobs + API), apps/playground-worker (DO consumers/scenarios/providers), packages/playground-contracts (private shared definitions/schemas/DTO). No packages/core migration or Nx/Turborepo. This repository structure is owner accepted. Inspect healthy current checkout and instructions, establish pins and disjoint paths; don't reset/repair owner's Git checkout. Owner specified no frontend styling/framework preference; foundation may recommend a minimal compatible choice and record it, ask only for materially unresolved product decisions, not repeatedly request permission to implement accepted scope.
After contracts and shared registrars delivered, dispatch independent CF PoC, scenarios, read API, live, UI and admin-capability study within actual implementor capacity (typically up to six). UI/live may use frozen contracts and mocks while CF integration is qualified; no fake claims of hosted PASS. Dependencies are in descriptions, not native stage barriers: validate readiness explicitly. Executor depends on CF PoC+scenarios; mutations depend on capability study+read API+scenarios; serial integration follows ready slices. Do not activate deferred SQLite UPVE-1874; hosting UPVE-1873 is prepare-only until separately authorized deployment.
Finite stages: foundation/implementation checkpoints <=90min, individual heavy gates <=10min, bounded CF PoC <=45min before concrete blocker report. Coordinator uses exact-child native completion waits at most one useful pending control, not loops/watchdogs or fake 30-second LLM polling. Record actual run/session/tool start, exact snapshots, ownership, consumed-report cursors, next readiness condition and honest blockers. Check original sessions if platform EOF/failure before duplicate dispatch. Do not repeat completed work or old release/reviews. Require durable evidence for actual checks, local/workerd/hosted distinctions, and preserve known upstream strict Drizzle/CF/network limitations.


## Accepted owner decision — repository structure
Owner accepted the lightweight workspace layout in this conversation. Keep the published effect-jobs library at repository root: src/, tests/, specs/, ai-docs/ and root package.json stay in place. Do NOT migrate the library into packages/core and do NOT introduce Turborepo/Nx solely for this playground.
- apps/website: documentation and /jobs dashboard in one application; documentation content in content/docs/, UI in src/features/jobs/, API/read/command services in src/server/.
- apps/playground-worker: Durable Object job consumers, deterministic scenarios and fake providers, with separate application dependencies.
- packages/playground-contracts: small private shared job definitions, schemas and DTO package used by both apps. No database clients, secrets, provider implementations or UI here.
Use workspace-local dependencies for development; also qualify consumers against the actual packed effect-jobs package so workspace resolution cannot hide release defects. Keep web dependencies out of published library dependencies and verify pack inventory/import isolation. specs/ remains normative library contracts, not replaced by website content. Code directories do not dictate separate domains/deployments; CF deployment boundaries remain subject to PoC. Confirm the package manager's supported root/workspace behavior before changing manifest/lock.
This decision resolves layout, NOT execution authorization. Issues remain unassigned backlog; no implementation, dispatch, provisioning, push/merge or deployment authorized by this update. Downstream ownership paths previously written as playground/** are conceptual areas and must map to this accepted layout via the serial foundation owner before parallel work. Current repo layout and owner files must be inspected and preserved.



Goal: real effect-jobs + PostgreSQL, fake application/providers, public live /jobs playground suitable for eventual hosting beside docs on an owner-selected domain (effect-jobs.com is a candidate, not purchased/approved). Use the dashboard as an ergonomics experiment and publish an honest capability/gap inventory. Prefer Cloudflare Workers + Alchemy Effect-native DO execution; Node is fallback only after concrete CF blocker and owner decision. Live uses DO WebSocket invalidations plus authoritative API snapshots, not Electric/LiveStore initially.
Shared read-only demo + isolated visitor sandboxes for mutations. Reproducible scenarios, bounded generation/cost/retention, explicit unsupported actions. No claim of production operational console. Domain, provider/SKU/budget, UI stack and execution repository remain foundation decisions; paid Workers plan does not authorize unlimited overage or a new PG resource.
Parallel plan: foundation first; CF PoC, scenarios, read API, live transport, UI and operator-capability study can then proceed independently against frozen contracts. Executor depends on CF PoC+scenarios. Operator mutations depend on capability study+read API+scenarios. Integration follows delivered slices; hosting follows qualified integration and separate exact deployment authorization. SQLite backend investigation is deferred, not critical path.
Acceptance: browser can create synthetic scenarios, watch true persisted transitions, filter/search/sort/page jobs, inspect privacy-safe details, exercise only supported safe actions, reconnect/reset within isolated sandbox; evidence covers concurrency, failures, cleanup and real CF runtime where authorized. Durable docs record setup, limitations, library findings and preview deployment prerequisites.


Authorization: backlog creation only. Unassigned; do not dispatch, provision even free resources, read/copy secrets, register a domain, publish packages, push/merge or deploy without separate owner authorization. Existing completed issues remain closed. Use canonical project workflow UPVE-1020 when execution is activated; no automatic review dispatch now. Preserve owner changes; inspect current library/source/package APIs, repository instructions and recursive ai-docs before implementation. Public playground is a separate application consuming effect-jobs, not admin features silently added to the library. No lifecycle UPDATE bypass or hidden fake library capabilities. Missing APIs become reproducible findings for owner decision.
Proposed ownership paths below are boundaries to finalize in foundation, not permission to choose an unapproved repository or overwrite existing files. One serial owner for shared contracts, dependency manifest/lock, route registrars, migrations and deployment configuration. Each parallel author gets isolated worktree and disjoint files. Handoff: exact base/head/tree, changed files, actual checks, limitations and durable evidence. No live payment/email/arbitrary outbound webhook; synthetic data only. PostgreSQL is authoritative; no plaintext/key leakage or cross-sandbox access.
